features.title: Strict identity export intake and configurable analysis policy
acceptance: Reject malformed JSON, duplicate keys/IDs, unknown references, cycles, invalid timestamps, and control characters before storage
Preview export findings under custom policy thresholds and toxic permission pairs without storing data
Deduplicate identical export bytes and preserve recorded policy

features.title: Inherited grant path resolution, risk triage, and finding reviews
acceptance: Resolve effective roles and permissions with deterministic shortest grant paths across nested groups and role inheritance
Compute evidence-backed findings for stale accounts, missing/unknown MFA, orphan services, toxic pairs, disabled grants, and concentration
Record optimistic-versioned finding review decisions and export safe CSV or JSON

features.title: Immutable remediation simulation and two-person plan approval
acceptance: Preview non-executing remediation plans over an immutable snapshot copy and report resolved, introduced, and remaining findings
Enforce independent reviewer approval distinct from the plan author with optimistic version checks

features.title: OIDC PKCE authentication, bounded audit log, policy evaluation, and aggregate LLM advice
acceptance: Authenticate via OIDC authorization code + PKCE or loopback-only local demo mode with CSRF and role enforcement
Provide reproducible synthetic stale-account threshold calibration and optional aggregate-only LLM advice with local fallback

features.title: Strict remediation action string validation and identity-scoped finding filter
acceptance: Reject control characters, unpaired surrogates, and surrounding whitespace in remediation action values (such as assign_owner) consistently with import and policy validation
Allow reviewers to filter identities by finding rule in SnapshotView so accounts triggering a specific risk rule can be isolated quickly
